Readers part on what the wrath of God is -- God's own response to evil, or what sin brings with it -- and the page takes no side.

Readers part on what the word says: a sacrifice that turns God's wrath aside (propitiation), one that removes sin (expiation), or both. The page sets the words and takes no side.
